meta.title: Mines — without guessing and without ads
meta.description: Open every cell without a mine: a number tells how many mines lie around it. Every field is solved by reasoning alone, never by guessing; hints are free. Three levels and fields of the day. No ads, accounts or tracking; works offline.

streak.one: Fields of the day: {n} day in a row
streak.other: Fields of the day: {n} days in a row

game.tipPlayer: Tap where you want to start: the first place is always safe.
game.tipZoom: Move the field with one finger; zoom with two.

mines.name: Mines
mines.boomRestart: There was a mine here. Start over — the same field — or take a new one.
mines.boomDaily: There was a mine here. Start the field of the day over.
mines.boomUndo: There was a mine here. Undo the move and go on.

wrongFlags.one: There is no mine under this flag.

mines.tip: Tap a closed cell to open it. A number tells how many mines lie around it. Hold a cell to put a flag on a mine.
mines.rules: A number on an open cell tells how many mines lie in the eight cells around it. Open every cell without a mine. A flag is a note for yourself: “a mine here”; it does not change the result.

about.title: About the game
about.text: Every field is solved by reasoning from the first place to the end, never by guessing. Hints are free and without limits. No ads, accounts or tracking: progress stays on this device. Works offline.
about.zoom: Large fields on a phone: one finger moves the field, two zoom it; “Whole field” shows all of it. With a mouse: the wheel moves the field, Ctrl and the wheel zoom.
about.keys: Keyboard: arrows — move over the cells, Space or Enter — like a tap, F — flag, H — hint, N — new field, Ctrl+Z — undo the move onto a mine, Esc — close.
